subject: Marketplace private offer: unit price mapping & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@brightcart.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: marketplace private offer & unit price discussion

Hi Emma - great to meet earlier. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery call:

Summary of BrightCart ask
- Use case: real-time product Q&A and transactional chat embedded in mobile/web.
- Expected steady-state usage: ~50M tokens/month with bursts to ~120M on campaign days.
- Initial procurement preference: AWS Marketplace private offer to keep PO/vendor consolidation.
- Target procurement / budget signal: looking for target $/1M tokens to evaluate against internal benchmarks.

Questions / asks for procurement
1) Can you confirm your target $/1M tokens or budget range you want us to aim for (ballpark is fine)?
2) Can you share any required procurement paperwork or marketplace contact (I attached a one-sheet to capture volumes).
3) If AWS Marketplace private offer is required, we will propose a list price that embeds the Marketplace pass-through so your PO lines up with your finance processes. Confirm you prefer list price to include marketplace fee.

Our next steps
- I'll loop in our pricing lead (Aditya) and ops (Stephanie) to produce a marketplace price mapping showing list price vs net price across AWS/GCP/Azure and by tier (0-10M, 10-50M, 50-200M, 200M+).
- If that looks good, we can draft the private offer and hand to the AWS rep to create the PO flow.

Proposed next meeting: 30 min on Wed to review the mapping - are you available 8/12 10am PT?

Thanks - attaching the brief we captured on volumes (brightcart_pricing_request.xlsx).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: brightcart_pricing_request.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Emma Li <emma.li@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: marketplace private offer & unit price discussion

Thanks Marissa - really useful summary. A few clarifications from procurement side:

1) Budget range: BrightCart is comfortable with a target band of $450-$650 per 1M tokens depending on committed volume and SLOs.
2) Expected volumes: Month 1 pilot 20-50M tokens, ramp to ~150M/month within 6 months if performance holds.
3) Procurement flow: We prefer to buy via AWS Marketplace private offer (PO-based) and will not approve direct invoices without a Marketplace PO. So please include Marketplace pass-through in list price.

Attached is a short procurement requirements doc and a template our finance team will use for the PO. Let me know if you need our AWS Marketplace rep contact - I can intro.

We can do Thu 8/12 10am PT to review your mapping.

Emma Li
Head of Procurement | BrightCart
emma.li@brightcart.com

Attachment(s): BrightCart_procurement_requirements.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: BrightCart procurement - need marketplace price mapping (AWS/GCP/Azure)

Quick draft mapping (assumptions inline):
Assumptions
- Target net to Redwood = ranges per tier (we aim to be within BrightCart band $450-$650 at list-net after fees)
- Marketplace pass-through fee: AWS 12%, GCP 10%, Azure 13% (these are estimates; legal ops may change).
- Unit = per 1,000,000 tokens.

Proposed list price -> net math (example):
- If target net = $600/1M, AWS list = 600 / (1 - 0.12) = $681 => round to $685 list => net to Redwood $603.8
- GCP list = 600 / (1 - 0.10) = $667 => round to $670 list => net $603
- Azure list = 600 / (1 - 0.13) = $689 => round to $695 list => net $605.65

Tiered starter table (recommended list / estimated net)
- 0-10M: list $1,050 /1M -> net AWS ~$924, GCP ~$945, Azure ~$914 (we price higher for small volumes)
- 10-50M: list $800 /1M -> net AWS ~$704, GCP ~$720, Azure ~$696
- 50-200M: list $685 /1M -> net AWS ~$603, GCP ~$617, Azure ~$597
- 200M+: list $560 /1M -> net AWS ~$493, GCP ~$504, Azure ~$487

Notes / questions for Marissa:
- Do we need to include any marketplace surcharge separately in the PO line (some customers require line-item for 'AWS fees') or do we keep it embedded in list price? BrightCart indicated they want list price to include marketplace fee.
- Legal: private offer T&Cs, minimum term and termination clauses - do we propose 12-month commit?

Attaching the draft PDF (redwood_marketplace_price_mapping_v1.pdf). I can refine the numbers for Thu 8/12 10am PT once Marissa confirms target-net target and term length.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Pricing Lead | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_marketplace_price_mapping_v1.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

From: Emma Li <emma.li@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer: unit price mapping & next steps

Hi Marissa / Aditya - thanks for the draft mapping, that looks aligned with our expectations. Procurement confirms:
- We will proceed via AWS Marketplace private offer. List price should include Marketplace pass-through.
- Preferred term: 12 months with quarterly usage reporting.
- Our internal target is to land between $500-$650 net for the 10-50M tier and $450-$550 net for 50-200M once committed.

Next actions:
1) Please send a PO draft and DocuSign-ready contract; I attached our preferred PO template.
2) Please loop in the AWS rep to initiate the private offer creation (cc'd).
3) We'll review the final list prices and sign once the private offer shows up in Marketplace.

Proposed next sync: Quick 15 min once AWS confirms private offer creation - we can do Tue 8/18 9am PT if you need.

Thanks - attaching PO draft (PO_draft_BrightCart.docx).

Emma Li
Head of Procurement | BrightCart
emma.li@brightcart.com
